correctness.rationale: For n≥4, Deshpande–Singh Theorem 4.6 supplies the exact one-degree homology concentration and ranks (3 when 4|n, otherwise 1). Fixed oriented simplex signs give reduced Lefschetz χ(g)=−(−1)^d∑_{g-invariant faces} (−1)^(number of occupied g-orbits). For rotations the four-state no-111 transfer matrix has characteristic polynomial t(t−1)(t²+1), so Z=1+2cos(π gcd(n,a)/2). For reflections palindromic orbit-words reduce to endpoint-constrained B_L with v(M²+I)=0, B_L=(−1)^floor(L/2), distinguishing all even-n reflection axes. This yields the exact displayed n mod4 rational character and quotient invariant dimensions (D_n nonzero iff n≡0,1,7 mod8). Independent direct orbit-face enumeration rebuilt the action and matched all 294 rotation/reflection Lefschetz values for n=4…17; these tests corroborate but do not prove all n.
